agency:v30.def.ops.ageing.en: Days since the case last moved: the latest of a pipeline stage change, an application status change or the assignment to this agency.

agency:v30.def.ops.backlog.en: Open work at the end of each week: team tasks (not the student's own to-dos) not yet done, document versions not yet reviewed, and essays submitted for review and not yet reviewed (current review round).

agency:v30.def.ops.blocked.en: A case is blocked when it waits on a party and has not moved for more than 14 days. Oldest first.

agency:v30.def.ops.deadlines.en: Applications not yet submitted whose application deadline is within 14 days and that are still missing required items.

agency:v30.def.ops.load.en: Weighted load per person: each kind of open work they hold × its weight (the agency's weight table), against their personal capacity in the same points. Overloaded = load above capacity. People on leave are not assigned new work.

agency:v30.def.ops.sla.en: First reply not given by its due time; documents waiting for review longer than 48 hours; essay reviews past the promised review time.

agency:v30.def.ops.stages.en: Median days an application stayed in a status before moving on (stays that ended in the last 365 days). Withheld below {{n}} stays.

agency:v30.def.ops.unassigned_paid.en: Paid for a Hangyul service, and no counselor owns the case (or, for Hangyul, no agency is assigned yet).

agency:v30.def.svc.arrival.en: Airport pickups completed ÷ pickups whose arrival time has passed (cancelled excluded)

agency:v30.def.svc.completion.en: Completed ÷ cases created in the period (cancelled excluded)

agency:v30.def.svc.resolution.en: Median hours from request to completion, completed cases only

agency:v30.def.svc.sla.en: Cases where the team acted after the SLA (or has not acted and the SLA passed) ÷ cases whose SLA has come due
